scope: Original4 development systems, representation compression only, not a shared neural encoder. Same observed fields, known source/loss/background, no true validation medium for inference. Training PCA uses additional labeled medium specs, no field simulation.
hypothesis: Physical generator compression may preserve phase better than field compression, but a fixed128-coordinate global PCA need not be sufficient beyond the one-way domain.
warning: Synthetic velocity perturbation is a sum of4axis-aligned Gaussian products; rank4SVD exploits this known construction, not universal separability.
